Title:
NETMESSAGE:'Pistol 18'

Secondary: 3-Round burst

'手枪 18'

Title:
NETMESSAGE:The 2040 Scraping Tommy
Old Thompson overgone some eerily destructive futuristic treatment. Now also packs an generator and grenade launcher, oh shit.
Primary: Automatic fire
Secondary: Grenade
Ammo: SMG Rounds / Alien Beacon Red Energy
Translation:
2040 刮削汤米
老汤普森经历了一些诡异的毁灭性未来处理。现在还装有一个发电机和榴弹发射器，哦靠。
主要开火：自动射击
次要开火：榴弹
弹药：冲锋枪子弹 / 异星信标红色能量

Title:
NETMESSAGE:The Webley Railgun
Old Webley revolver tuned up as an coil-powered, plasma-firing contraption. Got something extremely fierce in our hands!
Primary: Explosive plasma projectile
Secondary: Bigger, charged blast
Ammo: Fusion Cells / Alien Beacon Red Energy
Translation:
韦伯利轨道炮
老式韦伯利左轮手枪被改装成线圈驱动、发射等离子体的玩意儿。我们手里有极其凶猛的东西！
主要开火：爆炸性等离子射弹
次要开火：更大的蓄力爆射
弹药：融合电池 / 异星信标红色能量
